notes.title: First patch update
notes.content:
- Fixed some loading issues
- Added pause button for individual planet sound clips
- Added play, pause, stop all sounds buttons
- Fixed Windows build issue

Please report any bug reports or feature requests in the discussion forum. Thanks!
